sentences.en: The mechanic fixed my car without charging me a dime.
sentences.zh: 修理工给我修好了车，一分钱都没收。

sentences.en: Take it to a mechanic, and get it fixed.
sentences.zh: 把它带到修理工那里去修一下。

sentences.en: Lawyers and auto mechanics are the people I trust the least.
sentences.zh: 我最不信任的几个人是律师和汽车修理工。

senses.zh: 机械工，机修工；<旧>劳工，工匠；方法，手段
